laminas-mime Source (Local Note)
================================
MIME message utilities bundled with laminas-mime.

Contents
--------
- Mime.php – MIME configuration and helpers.
- Message.php – MIME message container.
- Part.php – MIME part representation.
- Decode.php – MIME decoding utilities.
- Exception/ – component exceptions (ExceptionInterface, InvalidArgumentException, RuntimeException).

Notes
-----
- Vendor code; do not edit. Refer to upstream README.md and LICENSE for full documentation.
- MIME handling is shared across Laminas mail components; prefer upstream updates for changes or fixes.
